scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent pauses of 35s and 38s while checking Openreach portals, prompting caller chasing on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely skipped account security verification, failing to request installation postcode, customer PIN, or security questions during the first 240 seconds or at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the customer by name ('Lily') throughout the entire 15-minute conversation.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring opening customer distress regarding lost wages and failed move-in installation, and offering cold corporate guideline deflections during an outburst in the final third.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never provided a restatement of the failed installation, severed dropwire, or work disruption, jumping straight into portal lookups.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused to take ownership of the installation failure, refusing to escalate to civils management or dispatch an emergency 4G backup dongle, unhelpfully instructing the customer to re-book online next month.

grader.scenario: Failed new property installation where external fiber drop cable was severed by tree branch
grader.notes: Failed new fiber installation call handled by Ryan. Contractor abandoned job due to severed overhead dropwire near tree. Agent probed physical setup well, but failed 6 criteria: Dead Air (two 30s+ gaps), Verified (skipped completely), Personalized (caller never named), Empathy (unhandled outbursts including final third), Paraphrasing (no restatement), and Ownership (refused escalation/backup dongle).
